import random
import string

def generate_test_case():
    s_len = random.randint(1, 300)
    s = ''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=s_len))
    
    wordDict_len = random.randint(1, 1000)
    wordDict = [''.join(random.choices(string.ascii_lowercase, k=random.randint(1, 20))) for _ in range(wordDict_len)]
    
    return s, list(set(wordDict))  # Remove duplicate words in wordDict
